cond_0001.intro: When you join [Company name masked] as a Validation Engineer, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world's leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Regulatory Compliance Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.
Responsible for preparing, executing commissioning and qualification documents for a variety of utility, facility, and process equipment. Develop and execute a variety of validation and FDA compliance related documents/protocols for pharmaceutical equipment. Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience with validation of pharmaceutical or medical device processes and equipment.
FAT, SAT, IQ and OQ documentation development and execution on Automated Systems in the Pharmaceutical Industry.
Excellent leadership skills including the ability to simultaneously organize, and successfully execute multiple project responsibilities.
Good communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with all levels of management, clients, and vendors.
Strong computer skills.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree.
Preferred Requirements
Validation experience in the areas of automation, packaging, cleaning, Computer systems, utilities and/or facilities.
Willing and able to travel as necessary for project requirements to include but not be limited to: project installation and start-up activities, client meetings, company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, or conventions, etc.

You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.
Responsible for preparing, executing commissioning and qualification documents for a variety of utility, facility, and process equipment. Develop and execute a variety of validation and FDA compliance related documents/protocols for pharmaceutical equipment. Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team.
cond_0111.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 3 years of experience with validation of pharmaceutical or medical device processes and equipment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with FAT, SAT, IQ and OQ documentation development and execution on Automated Systems in the Pharmaceutical Industry.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to communicate effectively and interact with management, clients, and vendors at all levels.
Working knowledge of computer tools and software relevant to the role.
Willingness and ability to travel as needed for project requirements, including installation and start-up activities, client meetings, company-sponsored meetings, trainings, and industry seminars or forums.
Preferred Requirements
Background in validation across areas such as automation, packaging, cleaning, computer systems, utilities, and/or facilities.
Openness to taking on multiple project responsibilities at once, with a willingness to develop organizational and leadership skills over time.

You will join our Regulatory Compliance Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.
cond_0199.responsibilities:
You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.
Responsible for preparing, executing commissioning and qualification documents for a variety of utility, facility, and process equipment. Develop and execute a variety of validation and FDA compliance related documents/protocols for pharmaceutical equipment. Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team.
cond_0199.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience with validation of pharmaceutical or medical device processes and equipment.
FAT, SAT, IQ and OQ documentation development and execution on Automated Systems in the Pharmaceutical Industry.
Excellent leadership skills including the ability to simultaneously organize, and successfully execute multiple project responsibilities.
Good communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with all levels of management, clients, and vendors.
Strong computer skills.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree.
Preferred Requirements
Validation experience in the areas of automation, packaging, cleaning, Computer systems, utilities and/or facilities.
Willing and able to travel as necessary for project requirements to include but not be limited to: project installation and start-up activities, client meetings, company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, or conventions, etc.
cond_0199.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.

In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world's leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Regulatory Compliance Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy. Most people become stronger in this kind of validation and compliance work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.

You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.
Responsible for preparing, executing commissioning and qualification documents for a variety of utility, facility, and process equipment. Develop and execute a variety of validation and FDA compliance related documents/protocols for pharmaceutical equipment. Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience with validation of pharmaceutical or medical device processes and equipment.

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree.
Good communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with all levels of management, clients, and vendors.
Willing and able to travel as necessary for project requirements to include but not be limited to: project installation and start-up activities, client meetings, company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, or conventions, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Validation experience in the areas of automation, packaging, cleaning, computer systems, utilities and/or facilities.
Excellent leadership skills including the ability to simultaneously organize and successfully execute multiple project responsibilities.
Strong computer skills.

In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world's leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Regulatory Compliance Practice and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of validation processes and FDA compliance requirements.
cond_0400.responsibilities:
You'll work individually and in teams to support capital projects and implement solutions for our clients. Together, you will help our clients make critical changes to improve their performance and realize their most important goals.
Responsible for preparing, executing commissioning and qualification documents for a variety of utility, facility, and process equipment. Develop and execute a variety of validation and FDA compliance related documents/protocols for pharmaceutical equipment. Make an impact day-to-day with your skills and expertise, strengthening that relationship with our clients and team.
cond_0400.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience with validation of pharmaceutical or medical device processes and equipment.
FAT, SAT, IQ and OQ documentation development and execution on Automated Systems in the Pharmaceutical Industry.
Excellent leadership skills including the ability to simultaneously organize, and successfully execute multiple project responsibilities.
Good communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with all levels of management, clients, and vendors.
Strong computer skills.
Willing and able to travel as necessary for project requirements to include but not be limited to: project installation and start-up activities, client meetings, company sponsored meetings, trainings, industry related seminars, forums, or conventions, etc.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree.
Preferred Requirements
Validation experience in the areas of automation, packaging, cleaning, Computer systems, utilities and/or facilities.
